definition: Output elasticity or income share assigned to capital, depending on the study.
comparison_rule: Compare only after checking whether the value is estimated, income-share based, or calibrated.

definition: Output elasticity or income share assigned to labor; often adjusted for self-employment.
comparison_rule: Adjusted and unadjusted labor shares are separate concepts.

definition: Residual productivity level after accounting for measured factor inputs.
comparison_rule: Meaning depends on normalization and included inputs; never compare index levels without a common base year.

definition: Annual average change in TFP or contribution of TFP to output growth.
comparison_rule: Keep Solow residual, human-capital-adjusted TFP, potential TFP, and contribution measures distinct.

definition: Annual average TFP growth for a specified sector and period.
comparison_rule: Compare only identical sector definitions and TFP methods.

definition: Productivity associated with formal labor in models that explicitly distinguish formality.
comparison_rule: Index levels require the same base year and model specification.

definition: Autoregressive persistence parameter of the unit-root/permanent technology process.
comparison_rule: Frequency-specific; quarterly and annual coefficients are not directly comparable.

definition: Autoregressive persistence parameter of the stationary technology process.
comparison_rule: Frequency-specific and model-dependent.

definition: Standard deviation of innovations to the permanent technology process.
comparison_rule: Comparable only under identical variable scaling and shock normalization.

definition: Standard deviation of innovations to the stationary technology process.
comparison_rule: Comparable only under identical variable scaling and shock normalization.

definition: Ease of substituting capital and labor while holding output constant.
comparison_rule: Aggregate, sectoral, and firm-level estimates should be compared separately.

name_en: Elasticity of substitution between capital-labor bundle and energy
name_tr: Sermaye-emek bileşimi ile enerji arasındaki ikame esnekliği
definition: Outer-nest substitution elasticity between a capital-labor composite and energy.
comparison_rule: Not equivalent to a direct capital-energy or labor-energy elasticity.

definition: Elasticity between formal and informal labor inputs.
comparison_rule: Distinguish Turkey estimates from calibrations imported from external literature.

definition: Percentage response of output to a common percentage increase in all inputs.
comparison_rule: A maintained constant-returns restriction is not an estimate.

definition: Fixed operating cost in the production technology.
comparison_rule: Record a normalization or steady-state condition separately from a numeric estimate.

definition: Multiplicative efficiency/scale parameter in a production function.
comparison_rule: Value depends on data normalization and cannot usually be compared across papers.

definition: Capital-side distribution parameter in a normalized CES function.
comparison_rule: May resemble a capital share but is not generally identical to an observed income share.

definition: Distribution weight on the capital-labor composite relative to energy in a nested CES function.
comparison_rule: Do not label as the aggregate capital share.

definition: Shape or growth parameter governing labor-augmenting technical progress.
comparison_rule: Distinguish model coefficient from the paper's derived average productivity growth.

definition: Shape or growth parameter governing capital-augmenting technical progress.
comparison_rule: Distinguish model coefficient from the paper's derived average productivity growth.

definition: Curvature parameter governing the time path of labor-augmenting productivity.
comparison_rule: Comparable only within the same functional form and time normalization.

definition: Curvature parameter governing the time path of capital-augmenting productivity.
comparison_rule: A value fixed at zero by model selection is not an unconstrained estimate.

definition: Average growth rate of labor productivity implied by or calculated in the model.
comparison_rule: Check whether this is raw output per worker, quality-adjusted labor productivity, or factor-augmenting productivity.

definition: Average growth rate of capital productivity implied by or calculated in the model.
comparison_rule: Check capital-stock construction and capacity-utilization adjustment.

definition: Utilized productive capacity as a share of installed capacity.
comparison_rule: Manufacturing surveys and whole-economy model variables are not interchangeable.

definition: Curvature or cost parameter governing variable capital utilization.
comparison_rule: Definition varies materially across DSGE models.

definition: Intermediate inputs as a share of production value or total production cost.
comparison_rule: Denominator must be explicit.

definition: Direct and/or indirect imported-input requirement of production or exports.
comparison_rule: Production and export content, and direct versus total requirements, must remain separate.

definition: Energy and water or energy-only cost as a share of production cost/output.
comparison_rule: Check whether energy includes water and whether petroleum feedstocks are treated as materials.

definition: Oil or petroleum input as a share of production cost or output.
comparison_rule: Not interchangeable with total energy share or import content.

definition: Percentage response of output to a one-percent change in public capital/infrastructure.
comparison_rule: Physical, social, and combined infrastructure definitions must be recorded.

definition: Fraction of capital stock depreciated per period.
comparison_rule: Keep annual and quarterly rates separate; note whether assumed, estimated, or observed-average.

definition: Estimated outward shift of the production frontier over time.
comparison_rule: Distinguish frontier technical change from Solow-residual TFP growth and factor-augmenting technical progress.

definition: Observed output relative to the estimated stochastic production frontier.
comparison_rule: Compare only studies using compatible frontier definitions, samples, and capital proxies.

definition: Annual change in distance from the estimated production frontier.
comparison_rule: Do not confuse the level of efficiency with its annual change.

definition: Annual productivity contribution from movements in production scale.
comparison_rule: Definition is decomposition-specific and should be reported alongside technical change and efficiency change.

definition: Response of output or labor productivity to ICT capital intensity.
comparison_rule: Check whether the dependent variable is output, value added, labor productivity, or TFP.

definition: Response of output or labor productivity to conventional capital intensity.
comparison_rule: Compare with ICT capital only within the same production-function specification.

definition: Output elasticity of employees using computers or the internet.
comparison_rule: Computer-user and internet-user definitions, firm size, and sector must remain visible.

definition: Output elasticity of labor not classified as ICT-using labor.
comparison_rule: Comparable only inside models that split total labor into ICT and non-ICT components.

definition: Association of software capital or investment intensity with firm productivity.
comparison_rule: Record whether the variable is a ratio, a logarithm, a stock, an investment flow, or a user dummy.

definition: Estimated productivity difference or coefficient associated with enterprise-resource-planning use.
comparison_rule: Binary-user coefficients, interactions, and causal treatment effects are separate variants.

definition: Estimated productivity difference or coefficient associated with customer-relationship-management use.
comparison_rule: Binary-user coefficients and interactions with ICT labor must be separated.

definition: Estimated productivity difference associated with website ownership or use.
comparison_rule: This is an association unless the design identifies a causal effect.

definition: Difference between observed and counterfactual log TFP under broadband adoption or non-adoption.
comparison_rule: Keep technology type, sector, treated/untreated status, and statistical significance separate.

definition: Model-calibrated or measured labor-productivity level for a named sector.
comparison_rule: Levels are normalization-dependent and should not be compared across models without a common base.

definition: CES distribution/share parameter governing female labor in sectoral production.
comparison_rule: It is not an observed female employment share; retain sector and calibration year.

name_tr: Tedarik zinciri yönetimi yazılımı verimlilik etkisi
definition: Estimated productivity difference or coefficient associated with supply-chain-management software use.
comparison_rule: Binary-user associations and causal effects are separate variants.

definition: Estimated productivity difference or coefficient associated with electronic data interchange use.
comparison_rule: Keep the source definition of EDI and the regression specification visible.

definition: Percentage response of output to a one-percent change in the human-capital input.
comparison_rule: Do not combine human-capital stock definitions based on schooling, returns to education, or quality adjustment without harmonization.

definition: Output response associated with raw-material or intermediate-material input.
comparison_rule: A first-order translog coefficient is not automatically an elasticity unless inputs are centered or evaluated at a stated point.

definition: Output response associated with electricity input.
comparison_rule: Keep electricity separate from aggregate fuel and total energy inputs.

definition: Output response associated with non-electric fuel input.
comparison_rule: The fuel basket differs across studies and must remain visible in the definition variant.

definition: Output response associated with petroleum consumption as a production input.
comparison_rule: Do not equate this elasticity with petroleum's cost or import share.

definition: Output response associated with natural-gas consumption as a production input.
comparison_rule: Comparable only under similar energy aggregation and production-function specifications.

definition: Output response associated with coal consumption as a production input.
comparison_rule: Comparable only under similar energy aggregation and production-function specifications.

definition: Output response associated with hydropower consumption or supply as a production input.
comparison_rule: The source's energy accounting and conversion units must be retained.

definition: Output response associated with biomass energy as a production input.
comparison_rule: The source's biomass coverage and energy conversion must be retained.

definition: Estimated substitution elasticity for an explicitly named pair of production inputs.
comparison_rule: Always filter by the two inputs, sector, period, and elasticity concept; Allen-Uzawa, Morishima, and direct elasticities are not interchangeable.

definition: Ratio measuring a group's frontier technology relative to the common metafrontier.
comparison_rule: Compare only within compatible metafrontier constructions and group definitions.

definition: Coefficient of a covariate in an estimated technical-inefficiency equation.
comparison_rule: The sign refers to inefficiency, so a negative coefficient generally implies higher efficiency; retain the covariate definition and model link.

definition: Share of the composite-error variance attributed to the one-sided technical-inefficiency component in a stochastic frontier model.
comparison_rule: This is not a technical-efficiency score; compare only under compatible distributional assumptions and frontier specifications.

definition: Percentage response of agricultural output to a one-percent change in cultivated land.
comparison_rule: Retain the land definition, crop coverage, and whether multiple cropping is counted.

definition: Output elasticity of a combined agricultural-input expenditure such as seed, fertilizer, and pesticide.
comparison_rule: The composition and valuation of the input bundle must be kept visible.

definition: Output response associated with an aggregate energy input.
comparison_rule: Do not combine total energy with electricity-only or fuel-only estimates.

definition: Output elasticity of labor directly engaged in production.
comparison_rule: Keep production workers separate from administrative or total labor.

definition: Output elasticity of administrative and non-production labor.
comparison_rule: Keep the source occupational classification visible.

definition: Estimated input-specific bias of technical change.
comparison_rule: The sign, scaling and named input must be retained; values multiplied by 100 in the source remain labelled as percent.

definition: Percentage response of output to tangible capital stock.
comparison_rule: Compare only with the same capital definition and estimation method.

definition: Percentage response of output to aggregate intangible capital.
comparison_rule: Software, patents and goodwill may be estimated jointly or separately.

definition: Percentage response of output to software capital.
comparison_rule: Distinguish an estimated stock elasticity from software-use dummy effects.

definition: Percentage response of output to patent capital.
comparison_rule: Retain the capitalization method and estimator.

definition: Percentage response of output to goodwill capital.
comparison_rule: Retain the accounting definition and estimator.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to livestock holdings.
comparison_rule: Compare only compatible livestock-equivalent measures.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to seed input.
comparison_rule: Retain whether seed is measured by quantity or expenditure.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to fertilizer input.
comparison_rule: Retain whether fertilizer is measured by quantity or expenditure.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to pesticide input.
comparison_rule: Retain whether pesticide is measured by quantity or expenditure.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to water or irrigation input.
comparison_rule: Irrigation access, water quantity and expenditure are not interchangeable.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to diesel input.
comparison_rule: Keep fuel definitions and valuation visible.

definition: Output elasticity of the source's residual other-cost bundle.
comparison_rule: The bundle is source-specific and should not be compared without checking composition.

definition: Percentage response of farm output to animal-feed input.
comparison_rule: Compare only compatible livestock/farm samples and feed measures.

definition: Regression coefficient of a named determinant of labor-productivity growth.
comparison_rule: Retain the named determinant, lag structure and estimator; this is not a production elasticity.

definition: Average percentage-point contribution of physical capital accumulation to output growth.
comparison_rule: Compare only decompositions with compatible capital stocks and periods.

definition: Average percentage-point contribution of human-capital accumulation to output growth.
comparison_rule: Retain schooling, return-to-education and labor-input assumptions.

definition: Curvature or scale parameter governing the cost of changing investment.
comparison_rule: Compare only identical adjustment-cost functions and normalizations.

definition: Parameter governing costs of changing the productive capital stock.
comparison_rule: Do not combine with investment-growth adjustment costs.

definition: Elasticity between domestic and imported inputs in the investment composite.
comparison_rule: Retain the nesting structure and domestic/import orientation.

definition: Weight of imported goods in the investment composite.
comparison_rule: Distinguish calibrated CES weights from observed import-content ratios.

definition: Weight of domestic goods in the investment composite.
comparison_rule: This may be one minus the imported weight only in a two-input nest.

definition: Geometric depreciation rate used in capital accumulation.
comparison_rule: Frequency and asset class must always be retained.

name_en: Elasticity of marginal depreciation to utilization
definition: Elasticity governing how depreciation cost changes with capital utilization.
comparison_rule: Compare only matching utilization-cost functional forms.

definition: Share assigned to an asset in the capital-services aggregate.
comparison_rule: Weights are aggregation parameters, not income shares.

definition: Investment expenditure relative to GDP targeted or implied in steady state.
comparison_rule: Keep gross/net and public/private coverage visible.

definition: Gross investment relative to the capital stock.
comparison_rule: Frequency and valuation basis are essential.

definition: Autoregressive persistence of an investment or marginal-efficiency shock.
comparison_rule: Do not mix marginal-efficiency and investment-specific technology shocks.

definition: Standard deviation of an investment or marginal-efficiency shock.
comparison_rule: Retain shock scaling and whether innovations are in logs.

name_en: Investment variance share explained by a shock
definition: Fraction of investment fluctuations attributed to a named structural shock.
comparison_rule: Shock name and horizon must be retained.

name_en: Output variance share explained by investment shock
definition: Fraction of output fluctuations attributed to an investment-related shock.
comparison_rule: Do not compare unconditional and forecast-error decompositions without labeling.

definition: Change in output per unit change in public investment.
comparison_rule: Impact, peak and cumulative multipliers are separate variants.

definition: Percentage response of output to a one-percent change in public investment.
comparison_rule: Do not equate elasticities with currency-unit fiscal multipliers.

definition: Elasticity of private investment with respect to public investment.
comparison_rule: Sign indicates crowding-in or crowding-out only under the source model.

name_tr: Özel yatırım denkleminde kamu yatırımı katsayısı
definition: Level or ratio coefficient of public investment in a private-investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain transformations and denominators; it is not automatically an elasticity.

definition: Coefficient of cash flow in a firm investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain cash-flow scaling, firm group, estimator and filtering.

definition: Coefficient of Tobin's q in a firm investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain q definition and normalization of investment.

definition: Linear leverage coefficient in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: When a squared term is present interpret jointly with it.

definition: Quadratic leverage coefficient in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Interpret jointly with the linear term and leverage scale.

definition: Leverage ratio at which the marginal investment effect changes sign.
comparison_rule: Derived from a particular quadratic specification.

definition: Coefficient of trade credit in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain whether trade credit is scaled by assets or capital.

definition: Coefficient of sales growth or sales-to-capital in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Accelerator and level specifications are not interchangeable.

name_tr: Reel faiz oranının yatırım üzerindeki etkisi
definition: Coefficient of the real interest rate or user cost in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain interest-rate maturity and units.

definition: Coefficient of aggregate output growth in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: This is not the same as a fiscal multiplier.

definition: Coefficient on lagged investment in a dynamic investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain lag length and normalization.

definition: Coefficient capturing nonlinear investment dynamics or adjustment costs.
comparison_rule: Interpret with the linear lagged-investment term.

definition: Change in investment-cash-flow sensitivity during supportive financial conditions.
comparison_rule: Retain the financial-conditions indicator definition.

definition: Change in investment-cash-flow sensitivity during expansionary monetary policy.
comparison_rule: Different monetary-stance indicators are separate variants.

definition: Change in investment-cash-flow sensitivity during a specified crisis.
comparison_rule: Retain the crisis window.

definition: Differential post-shock investment response associated with pre-shock leverage.
comparison_rule: Continuous and high-debt-dummy treatments are separate.

name_en: Public domestic-debt effect on private investment
name_tr: Kamu iç borcunun özel yatırıma etkisi
definition: Long- or short-run elasticity of private investment to public domestic debt.
comparison_rule: Retain debt definition and horizon.

name_en: Public external-debt effect on private investment
name_tr: Kamu dış borcunun özel yatırıma etkisi
definition: Elasticity of private investment to public external debt.
comparison_rule: Do not combine debt stock and debt-service effects.

name_en: External debt-service effect on private investment
name_tr: Dış borç servisinin özel yatırıma etkisi
definition: Elasticity of private investment to public external debt service.
comparison_rule: Retain public/private coverage and horizon.

definition: Coefficient of available credit in a private-investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain real/nominal measure, transformation and denominator.

definition: Coefficient of capacity utilization in a private-investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain lag and level/log specification.

definition: Coefficient of imported investment goods in a private-investment equation.
comparison_rule: This is distinct from the import share of an investment composite.

definition: Coefficient linking output or demand changes to private investment.
comparison_rule: Retain exact accelerator variable and lag.

definition: Coefficient used to construct a Turkey-specific firm financial-constraint index.
comparison_rule: Use only with the named variable and index specification.

definition: Debt-to-GDP threshold used to distinguish fiscal regimes.
comparison_rule: This is a model classification threshold, not a debt target.

definition: Coefficient of firm size in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain whether size is log assets or employment.

definition: Coefficient of firm age in an investment equation.
comparison_rule: Retain whether age is level or logarithm.

definition: Observed investment divided by capital, assets or GDP as defined by the source.
comparison_rule: The denominator and firm/public/private coverage are mandatory.

definition: Productive capital stock relative to output.
comparison_rule: Retain valuation method, asset coverage and frequency.

definition: Growth rate of a physical or productive capital stock.
comparison_rule: Retain asset/sector coverage and whether gross or net.

name_en: Investment variance share explained by TFP shock
definition: Fraction of investment fluctuations attributed to a TFP shock.
comparison_rule: Keep horizon and decomposition convention.

name_en: Investment variance share explained by risk-premium shock
name_tr: Yatırım varyansında risk primi şokunun payı
definition: Fraction of investment fluctuations attributed to a country-risk-premium shock.
comparison_rule: Keep horizon and decomposition convention.

name_tr: Özel yatırım denkleminde kamu borcu katsayısı
definition: Coefficient on a public-debt variable in a private-investment equation.
comparison_rule: Do not label a ratio-on-ratio level coefficient as an elasticity; preserve debt definition and scaling.
